name: My Lovely Nurse
source:
Ten nights. One hospital room. And a nurse who only comes after midnight.

You have ten more days to spend in the hospital. Tests, medication, endless checkups, and lonely nights in a private room—it seemed that nothing interesting was going to happen here.

But one night, after midnight, Lilith comes to visit you.

She claims that she wants to help you relax and offers an unusual ten-step program. With each passing night, the professional distance between patient and nurse grows thinner, the conversations become more intimate, and the attraction between you grows stronger.

Can you discover what Lilith truly wants? And what will happen when the final night arrives?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4954240/My_Lovely_Nurse/]Steam[/url]]
